subject: Dedicated capacity performance validation — SLO & sizing follow-up
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acmehealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-10T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity performance validation — SLO & sizing follow-up

Hi Emily — great to speak earlier today. Thanks for walking through Acme Health's latency and throughput goals; summarizing the key points and proposed next steps so we have an aligned plan.

Summary of target SLOs you mentioned:
- Interactive chat (short responses, streaming): p50 first-byte < 120 ms, p95 first-byte < 400 ms
- Completion latency (end-to-end for 512 tokens): p50 < 250 ms, p95 < 700 ms
- Sustained throughput target: ~6k requests/hour (≈1.7 reqs/sec) with peaks up to 5k concurrent streams during business hours
- Concurrency: support 300–500 concurrent active sessions with streaming; burst to 1k acceptable for short windows
- Streaming requirements: chunked streaming with first token within 120 ms and steady chunk sizes ≈64–128 tokens every 100–200 ms

Initial sizing recommendation (ballpark; we'll validate with a run):
- H100 path: 2x H100 (reserved) should meet p50/p95 for streaming at ~400–500 concurrent sessions for the model profile we discussed (instruction-tuned, ~13B). H100 gives better single-stream latency and streaming throughput.
- A100 path: 4x A100 (reserved) as a cost-optimized option for similar sustained throughput but slightly higher p95 tail/longer cold-starts for streaming.
- Test plan: dedicated perf validation comparing H100 vs A100 for: seq_len 128 & 512, batch sizes 1–8, concurrency sweep 50→1000, and real streaming chunk cadence.

Attachments: I included a short sizing doc and SLO table to make it easy to tune parameters (redwood-dedicated-sizing-v2.pdf, SLO_table.xlsx).

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the two models and seq_len envelope you want tested (we default to redwood-instruct-13B and redwood-chat-7B for comparison).
2) We schedule a dedicated perf run (2–3 business days) with our infra team; we’ll share the test harness and scripts beforehand.
3) Walkthrough of results with your ML/SRE team and finalize reserved capacity recommendation + pricing.

Would Wednesday morning (10/13) for the kickoff call work? If so, we’ll lock the perf window the following week.

Thanks — looking forward to validating this with you.

— Neha

Thanks Neha — this is very helpful and matches what we discussed. A couple clarifications before we kick off: 

- Models: Confirming redwood-instruct-13B as the primary; please include redwood-chat-7B as a baseline for CPU-constrained endpoints.
- Peak behavior: the 1k concurrent streams would be short (5–10 min) during sync windows; sustained concurrency target is 300–500.
- Data: we will provide a small, representative anonymized prompt set and token distribution for the test harness. No PHI in test data.

Yes to the kickoff on Wed 10/13 at 10:00 AM PT. Please send a calendar invite and the perf plan. Also want a rough cost delta H100 vs A100 (ballpark $/month) so we can bring to procurement.

— Emily

Aditya / Marissa — looping you in to confirm test scope and run owners. Emily from Acme Health confirmed models and is ready to provide anonymized prompt set. Key asks from our side:

- Perf plan: run H100 (2x), A100 (4x) configurations against redwood-instruct-13B and redwood-chat-7B; sequence lengths {128, 512}; concurrency sweep 50, 200, 500, 1000; streaming chunk cadence 64 tokens / 150 ms.
- Metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99 latency for first byte and completion, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, effective reserved throughput, tail-latency breakdown by step, and failure/retry counts.
- Security: test harness will run in a customer-dedicated VPC; Emily confirmed no PHI and will provide sanitized prompts.

Aditya — can your team own the validation run and provide the perf scripts? If you can, please also include an initial cost estimate (monthly reserved) for the two options so we can give Acme a rough delta before procurement.

I attached a draft perf-validation-plan.docx with the sequence of tests and expected deliverables. Kickoff with Emily is Wed 10/13 10:00 AM PT — I'll send the invite.

Thanks — Neha

Thanks — I can take this on. Quick notes on implementation and timing:

Plan:
- Test infra: We’ll spin up ephemeral dedicated clusters in our staging VPC mirroring customer Dedicated environment. We'll run the harness that records per-request traces and streaming latencies.
- Model binaries: will run redwood-instruct-13B (fp16 + Q4f16 profile) and redwood-chat-7B (fp16) on both GPU types.
- Run schedule: 10/14–10/16 for data collection (3 days) to capture variability. 10/19 for analysis and 10/20 for review with Acme.

Preliminary sizing & cost (ballpark monthly reserved cost to present to Acme):
- 2x H100 reserved pool: expected to handle ~450 concurrent streaming sessions at targeted latency; estimated monthly reserved cost: ~$45,000/month.
- 4x A100 reserved pool: expected to handle ~400 concurrent streaming sessions with slightly higher p95; estimated monthly reserved cost: ~$32,000/month.

I’ll prepare the perf scripts and share a link to the run configuration and a short README by tomorrow EOD. Marissa — can you confirm preferred acceptance criteria format (CSV + dashboard screenshots) for customer deliverable?

— Aditya
